title: Generic tracker providers remain legacy-only
tldr: Add upstream Asana, Jira, and GitLab polling and tools without weakening the fork's authoritative broker boundary.

title: Bounded indexed orchestration evidence sidecars
tldr: Briefed workers receive a compact 8 KiB manifest plus a broker-owned indexed YAML evidence sidecar capped at 8 MiB.

title: Workers are tracker-credential free
tldr: Symphony brokers all tracker reads and writes while workers receive only immutable evidence and no tracker credential.

title: Broker-owned PR snapshot and inline review closeout
tldr: Symphony's broker owns both PR evidence reads and inline-thread closeout; workers receive only an immutable snapshot.

title: Isolate worker tool caches
tldr: Symphony gives every Codex app-server worker a temporary writable cache root and removes it with the session.

title: Review budget counts complete automatic rework cycles
tldr: A review budget of three permits three review-and-rework cycles followed by one confirmation review, not only three review verdicts.

title: Broker publishes verified pull-request commits
tldr: Detached Codex workers commit locally while Symphony's broker verifies, integrates, and non-force publishes the resulting PR head before any state transition.

title: Acknowledge state-less webhook drift and untracked review feedback
tldr: Symphony journals configured-Codex review feedback as no-effect only when the live pull request has zero canonical state labels, while ambiguity and read failures remain quarantined or retryable.

title: Preflight does not authorize worker execution
tldr: Symphony derives each worker's execution mode and permitted outcome from tracker state; the read-only preflight supplies evidence only.

title: Forgejo is a first-class tracker provider
tldr: Symphony uses a separate Forgejo v16 adapter while sharing workflow-state policy and broker safety with the GitHub adapter.

title: Webhook registration does not gate runtime startup
tldr: Symphony starts independently of transient GitHub webhook registration failures and retries registration for the lifetime of the runtime process.

title: Symphony owns tracker workflow state
tldr: Symphony serializes every automated workflow transition and projects one canonical state to the tracker; workers return semantic outcomes and never mutate workflow state directly.
